content.title:
XXL on Instagram: "Pooh Shiesty and his father have reportedly been arrested following a raid on their family home in Tennessee. 

On Thursday (April 2), TMZ broke the news that the Memphis rapper, born Lontell Williams Jr., was taken into custody by authorities in Dallas. This report comes after news that Pooh's dad, Lontrell Williams Sr., was arrested by the FBI in Tennessee on April 1. The charges against the two men have yet to be announced. 

News of the arrests comes after search and arrest warrants were executed on a home in Cordova, Tenn., owned by Pooh or his father. Rumors have circulated that the raid and arrests have something to do with a robbery involving Gucci Mane earlier this year. 

50 Cent weighed in on the news on Thursday. Sharing a screenshot of news of Pooh's father's arrest, Fif captioned the photo, "WTF going on here?" 

XXL has reached out to Pooh Shiesty's team and attorney for comment."
